text:
Nora: Quick FYI  we've discovered a subtle permissions regression in the interviewer training portal. Some new hires can't access the 'Advanced Interviewing' module — they get a 403 on the training link. Spotted when onboarding cohort T7 reported blocked modules.

Devon: Which cohort? any shared attributes?

Nora: T7 (started Monday). Most are contractor hires and have accounts created via the new SSO invite flow.

Sasha: I traced it: when SSO accounts are provisioned, we set `role=interviewer-temp` in the identity service. The training portal ACLs expect `role=interviewer` (no temp). So the module gate denies access.

Marta: Oof. That's on me  we added the `interviewer-temp` role to the identity schema last week for contractors and forgot to update downstream ACL mappings.

Devon: Short-term fix: add `interviewer-temp` as alias to interviewer group in training portal config so cohort can access. Long-term: update provisioning docs.

Nora: Can you do the alias now? We have three scheduled prep sessions this afternoon.

Devon: On it. Doing config change now.

hr-bot: Change deployed to training-config: added role_aliases: {"interviewer-temp": "interviewer"}. Note: restart not required.

Sasha: Verified access for two repro accounts. They can open Advanced Interviewing module.

Marta: I'll issue a retro note in onboarding docs and add a checklist item: "If new role variants are added, update downstream ACL alias map." Also will run a query to find accounts with `interviewer-temp` and flag if any other modules are blocked.

Nora: Thank you. Also can we add a healthcheck that runs an auth check for each training module for a sample account after deploys?

Devon: Good idea. I'll add a synthetic check that uses a service account per role type. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Marta: I'll handle comms to the cohort and apologize briefly; note that everything is fixed now.

Nora: Cool. closing this thread. If anyone sees further access issues ping me. :sparkles:
